SCENE sc_001 0-70500 INT. ABANDONED BEDCHAMBER – PRE-DAWN
EP50:E1 0-1800 CAMERA: High overhead birds-eye shot looking straight down at the unkempt bed, where Catherine lies curled in a silk chemise against Father Thomas's bare chest.
EP50:E2 0-2000 ACTION: Father Thomas lies flat on his back, breathless, while Catherine rests beside him, her fingers tracing across his bare skin.
EP50:E3 1800-7000 CAMERA: Low-angle medium close-up on Catherine looking down adoringly into Father Thomas's face, a single candle flickering in the dark background.
EP50:E4 1800-5800 CATHERINE [Playful, Seductive]: "A man in your collar isn't supposed to have that much left in him, Thomas."
EP50:E5 5800-7200 ACTION: Catherine runs her hand gently down his chest, smiling with triumphant affection.
EP50:E6 7000-11800 CAMERA: Close-up on Father Thomas turning his head toward her on the pillow, his voice raspy and dry.
EP50:E7 7200-11200 FATHER THOMAS [Low, Ironical]: "A man in my collar isn't supposed to be in this bed at all."
EP50:E8 11800-15800 CAMERA: Close-up pushing in on Catherine as she leans lower over his face, her gaze sharpening with dangerous intimacy.
EP50:E9 12000-15500 CATHERINE [Intense, Whispering]: "Then let's stop pretending this was only appetite."
EP50:E10 15800-18800 CAMERA: Medium two-shot from the side as both sit up in bed, sheets pulled up around their waists.
EP50:E11 16800-18500 CATHERINE [Direct, Transactional]: "Name your price."
EP50:E12 18800-26500 CAMERA: Medium profile close-up on Father Thomas sitting up tall and bare-chested, Catherine resting her hand firmly over his heart.
EP50:E13 19400-25000 FATHER THOMAS [Calculated, Demanding]: "The west territory. Tax collection, all of it. Routed through my office."
EP50:E14 26500-30500 CAMERA: Slight pull back as Catherine pulls her hand back slightly, staring at him in disbelief.
EP50:E15 27200-30200 CATHERINE [Scoffing, Incredulous]: "That's not absolution, Thomas. That's a fortune."
EP50:E16 30500-35800 CAMERA: Two-shot centering on Father Thomas leaning toward her, his expression resolute and uncompromising.
EP50:E17 31000-35000 FATHER THOMAS [Steady, Cold]: "Absolution is free. Discretion has a price."
EP50:E18 35800-39800 CAMERA: Tight profile close-up between their faces, golden candlelight illuminating Catherine's jaw as she raises her hand to touch his cheek.
EP50:E19 36500-39400 CATHERINE [Soft, Calculating]: "Unsupervised. In your hands alone."
EP50:E20 39800-43000 CAMERA: Tight close-up as Father Thomas reaches up and firmly clasps Catherine's hand at his neck.
EP50:E21 40400-42500 FATHER THOMAS [Grave]: "For as long as it holds."
EP50:E22 43000-48500 CAMERA: Medium close-up as Catherine breaks into a knowing, seductive smile and taps his chest with her index finger.
EP50:E23 43200-48000 CATHERINE [Softly, Teasing]: "Done. You told yourself this ends when the hearing does."
EP50:E24 48500-54500 CAMERA: Close-up on Father Thomas letting out a soft, self-deprecating chuckle before meeting her eyes with smoldering hunger.
EP50:E25 49800-54000 FATHER THOMAS [Chuckle, Resigned]: "I've told myself that since the dawn in your bedchamber, and here we are again."
EP50:E26 54500-59800 CAMERA: Extreme close-up of their lips almost grazing, warm candlelight catching the edges of their profiles.
EP50:E27 54800-56500 CATHERINE [Murmuring]: "In another room no one uses?"
EP50:E28 56800-59200 FATHER THOMAS [Whispering]: "Perhaps I like rooms no one uses."
EP50:E29 59800-65500 CAMERA: Close-up profile as Catherine slides both hands into the dark hair at the back of his neck, pulling him closer.
EP50:E30 60300-64800 CATHERINE [Low, Carnal]: "Or perhaps discretion isn't the only thing you've developed a taste for."
EP50:E31 65500-70500 CAMERA: Medium two-shot as Father Thomas pulls Catherine into a fierce, suffocating embrace, burying his face in her neck while she clings to his broad shoulders.
EP50:E32 65800-70500 ACTION: Catherine closes her eyes in surrender as Father Thomas holds her tight against his naked chest, lost in their forbidden entanglement.
SCENE sc_002 70500-80000 INT. MANOR CORRIDOR – CONTINUOUS
EP50:E33 70500-73500 CAMERA: Medium tracking shot following Agnes as she walks cautiously down the dimly lit stone corridor, holding a black iron lantern.
EP50:E34 70800-73500 ACTION: Agnes scans the desolate hallway nervously, her lantern casting elongated shadows against the wall.
EP50:E35 73500-76500 CAMERA: Over-the-shoulder shot behind Agnes as she stops dead in front of an open doorway, peering inside.
EP50:E36 74000-76500 ACTION: Through the crack of the door, Agnes sees Catherine and the shirtless priest locked in an intimate, passionate embrace upon the bed.
EP50:E37 76500-78500 CAMERA: Tight close-up on Agnes's face, drained of all color, her eyes bulging in pure terror.
EP50:E38 76800-78500 ACTION: Agnes's jaw drops open in shock as she stifles a cry.
EP50:E39 77200-78600 SOUND: Sharp, terrified gasp catching in Agnes's throat.
EP50:E40 78500-80000 CAMERA: Frantic backward tracking close-up on Agnes stumbling back into the shadows of the hallway, horrified by the lethal secret she has uncovered before an abrupt cut to black.
